units.tick: log_1.0001(NVDA_raw / USDG_raw); token0 USDG (6 dec), token1 NVDA (18 dec); higher tick = lower NVDA price
units.liq: active liquidity L per 10-tick bucket, quantised: L = q × lScale
units.flow: [frameIndex, tickBefore, tickAfter, pickedCents] strongest informed swaps (picked_hl_1h > 0) per frame, closed window only
units.flowFrame: [pickedCents (positive part), lpFeeCents] pool-wide per frame, closed window only
units.control: running totals in cents for the $1k always-in-range control lane (replay lvr.controlLane definition)

lane.note: Lane A: $50 straddle placed on fair value before the close; held (not exited, not re-centred) through the closed window. After the window it planned a straddle on fair value, and the cost hurdle held it (benefit < 2× gas).

controlLane.definition: $1,000 in a ±100-tick straddle kept centred on the pool price (always in range), sharing each swap pro rata to its share of the active liquidity at tick_before (M1 attribution rule); picked-off = HL-referenced 1 h markout (picked_hl_1h), valid markouts only

lvr.statement: A control lane in range all through the 48 h closed window ($1k, ±100 ticks) paid $4.24 to informed flow and earned $3.32 in fees (net −$0.92). DeltaDesk added no risk while closed (every risk-adding step was gated; a position placed before the close is held, not exited, in M2).
